subject.title: Security: add configurable unpaired DM responses

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in `unpairedResponse` config that keeps `branded` as the default, and if so should the existing exported pairing formatter remain string-only or become a versioned nullable API?
rationale: The security goal, upgrade compatibility, and plugin/API contract cannot be settled safely by code review alone because the PR changes a user-facing default surface and an exported formatter contract.

options.title: Refresh With Stable Contract
options.body: Keep or version the formatter contract, port the branch to current extension paths, and require every advertised schema/runtime path plus proof to align before merge.

options.title: Accept Nullable Formatter
options.body: Maintainers can deliberately accept `string | null` only with explicit plugin-compatibility discussion, contract tests, and upgrade expectations for external callers.

options.title: Replace The Branch
options.body: If the branch is too stale to repair cleanly, keep the canonical issue open and land a narrower current-main implementation that credits this source work.

recommendation.title: Refresh With Stable Contract
recommendation.body: Keep or version the formatter contract, port the branch to current extension paths, and require every advertised schema/runtime path plus proof to align before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the assigned PR and authored the proposed config/API direction that needs confirmation.
